name: Desert Safari (Evening)
description: Classic evening desert safari in the Red Dunes of Dubai. Dune bashing, camel ride, BBQ dinner at the camp, live entertainment.

name: Morning Safari
description: Early morning desert safari with sunrise views over the red dunes. Sandboarding, quad ride, light breakfast.

name: Short Desert Safari
description: Quick desert experience — perfect for those short on time. Dune bashing and photo stop at the red dunes.

name: Morning Quad — Kymco 350cc
description: Solo quad biking in the morning desert. Great for beginners and intermediate riders. No driving licence required.

name: Morning Quad — Polaris Sportsman 570cc
description: Powerful solo quad biking in the morning desert for more experienced riders. No driving licence required.

name: Evening Buggy — Polaris RZR 1000cc
description: High-performance side-by-side buggy experience in the afternoon dunes. Can fit 1–2 riders.

name: Two Hours Buggy — Polaris RZR 1000cc
description: Extended 2-hour buggy ride for a more immersive desert experience. Can fit 1–2 riders.

name: Can Am Maverick X3 (2-seater)
description: Premium Can Am Maverick X3 Turbo — the ultimate desert buggy for 1–2 riders. High speed, maximum adrenaline.

name: Can Am Maverick X3 (4-seater)
description: Premium Can Am Maverick X3 for the whole family or group — up to 4 riders. Best desert performance.

name: Safari + Quad Combo
description: Best of both worlds — full evening safari with BBQ dinner plus a quad bike session in the dunes.
